stem.text: Which statement is correct about how oxygen combines with haemoglobin?

A.text: Combining all four oxygen molecules with haemoglobin does **not** affect the shape of haemoglobin.

B.text: One oxygen molecule can combine with each haem group of the haemoglobin molecule.

C.text: The first oxygen molecule to combine with haemoglobin **does not** affect the shape of haemoglobin.

D.text: The third oxygen molecule to combine with haemoglobin makes it more difficult for the fourth oxygen molecule to combine with haemoglobin.
